name: write-large-file
description: Write large files reliably using chunked bash append (>> heredoc)

interface.shortDescription: Write large files reliably using chunked bash append (>> heredoc)
interface.longDescription: Writes files longer than approximately 150 lines reliably by splitting the content into chunks and appending each chunk using bash heredocs (>>). This avoids the timeouts and context-window issues that can occur when a single Write tool call tries to create a very large file. Use this skill when generating reports, review documents, analysis summaries, generated code, or any structured document with multiple sections that would exceed the safe single-write limit.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use the write-large-file skill for this task.
